artifacts.notes: Extent as the retrieving lane measured it: Complete uncorrected OCR text layer of the Internet Archive scan of Migne, Patrologia Latina vol. 78 (750 page images), 132,030 lines; the running head 'PATROL. LXXVIII.' is printed on the page and confirms the volume. It carries the whole volume, i.e. Menard's Liber Sacramentorum (cols. 25-240), his Notae (263-582), Rocca's Scholia (583), the Benedictionale (601-637), the Liber Antiphonarius (641-723), the Liber Responsalis (723-849), and the Ordines Romani. Uncorrected optical recognition: it is a locating and searching layer, not a text of record, and wording quoted from this volume was collated against page images rather than taken from here. This is the file against which the lane's whole-volume negative searches were run, so a bounded negative taken from this volume is replayable here and only here.

work.description: Volume 78 of Migne's Patrologia Latina, the volume of the Roman liturgical books ascribed to Gregory the Great. It is registered as a container volume rather than under any one of its constituents because this run read several of them from the same bytes: Hugo Menard's edition of the Liber Sacramentorum at columns 25-240, Menard's Notae at 263-582, Angelo Rocca's Scholia at 583, the Benedictionale at 601-637, the Liber Antiphonarius at 641-723, the Liber Responsalis at 723-849, and the Ordines Romani, of which Ordo XIII was read at columns 1113-1114. A constituent that later acquires its own work record takes a segment over these artifacts rather than a duplicate copy of them.
